summary: Loma Negra filed its annual report on Form 20-F for fiscal year 2025 with the SEC, a routine periodic filing. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is announced. The press release accompanying the Form 6-K merely announces the availability of the annual report and provides contact information for requesting a hard copy. Therefore, this is a routine regulatory filing with no special-situation implications.
